summary: lineinfile options: attributes, backrefs (only replaces when regexp matches, ignores insert options), backup, create if missing, encoding, and firstmatch for insertafter/insertbefore.
questions: How do I use regex capture groups in the replacement line?
Why doesn't lineinfile add my line when backrefs is on?
How do I create the file if it doesn't exist?
How do I insert after the first match instead of the last?

answer_card.title: lineinfile backrefs, create, firstmatch
answer_card.answer_md:
- `backrefs` (false): `line` can use `\1` or `\g<name>`; if `regexp` doesn't match, file is **unchanged**; insert options ignored; excludes `search_string`
- `create` (false): create file if missing (otherwise fails)
- `firstmatch` (false): insertafter/insertbefore use first match
- `backup` (false), `encoding` (utf-8), `attributes`
